rows.basis: inheritance tax on each heir's share: between ascendants, descendants and spouses (higher scales for siblings, uncles and nephews, and others)
rows.note: Under review: rate read in the text of Ley 113 as published in 2012 (GOC-2012-O53); the 2026 budget law (Ley 181) applies the tax under Ley 113 but later amendments to this provision could not be checked (ONAT's site was unreachable).
